pages.text: All $(item)Traffic Light$()s run on one clock: green, yellow, red, with north-south and east-west taking turns. Put one up facing each road into a crossing. Redstone holds a light on red.

$(l)Cameras:$() a light's owner right-clicks it to set a fine for running its red; a $(item)Speed Limit Sign$()'s owner sets the limit and a speeding fine. Fines come out of the car owner's bank account, go to the camera's owner, and put penalty points on the driver's $(l:business/dmv)license$(/l).
